scoring.coldWarmCalls: at most two cold semantic calls and one warm semantic call
scoring.correctness: at least four net paired wins with one-sided exact p <= 0.10
scoring.decision: GO only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_GO
scoring.efficiency: at least 20% lower end-to-end time or 25% fewer total tool calls
scoring.naturalSelection: at least 15 of 18 production cells deliver applicable prepare and impact results
scoring.progressiveBytes: initial complete CallToolResult bytes at least 50% lower
scoring.progressiveCalls: no extra median follow-up call; proof access counted separately
scoring.progressiveQuality: identical correctness, zero coordinate-role errors, no hidden unresolved site
scoring.progressiveTokens: reported downstream tokens at least 25% lower
